name: LLMCheck Apple Silicon LLM benchmark dataset (CSV export)
notes: Open dataset of measured tok/s + TTFT on Apple Silicon Macs (M1..M6, Pro/Max/Ultra), 259 rows. Each row: model, params, quant, chip, RAM GB, engine (Ollama/MLX/LM Studio/llama.cpp), tps, ttft s, test date. Site labels each figure sourced/community/estimated; the CSV rows are the machine-readable form. Decode = avg tps for a chat-style generation.
